what_matters.head: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive and left its board, effective immediately. Nvidia closed down 4.3%, about 1.8 times its usual daily move.
what_matters.detail: Nvidia announced it on Thursday 12 Nov before the New York open. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is interim chief executive and stays CFO. Director Harvey C. Jones becomes the board's first chair, and the board will look at internal and external candidates. The release gives no reason; it follows Wednesday's reports about his relationships (yesterday's briefing). The shares opened down more than 13% and hit a 52-week low before recovering (CNBC). Results stay on 17 Nov in New York, as scheduled.

what_matters.head: Nebius fell 16.8%, about 2.8 times its usual daily move, after its Q3 results.
what_matters.detail: Revenue was $980.8M against the $907.5M analysts expected. But it now expects 2026 revenue at the low end of its $3.0–3.4B range, and raised 2026 capital spending to about $27B from $20–25B. It plans $40–45B in 2027, against the $28.8B analysts expected (CNBC). Delivery at several rented data-centre sites has slipped into the first half of 2027, including the rest of the New Jersey capacity contracted with Microsoft (GuruFocus).

what_matters.head: Cerebras rose about 17% after hours following its Q3 results. That move is not in Thursday's US prices.
what_matters.detail: Core revenue was $230.9M, up 70% from a year earlier, against its own forecast of about $214–216M. Core gross margin was 41%. It raised its 2026 core revenue outlook to $940–960M and expects to triple revenue in 2027 (company release). On the call it said Microsoft signed a deal in October, with revenue starting in Q1 2027; size and term were not given (CNBC).

latest.tape_note: On Thursday the S&P 500 fund fell 0.35%, the Nasdaq 100 fund 0.32% and the chip fund 0.26%. The 10-year yield rose 10 basis points to 5.10%, about 1.9 times its usual daily move, on the first bond session since Wednesday's Veterans Day holiday. CNBC tied it to higher oil and expectations of more Fed rate rises. US crude rose 1.9% and gold fell 1.9%. The dollar index rose 0.2%, and the US dollar rose 0.2% against the Singapore dollar. The VIX rose 6.9%.

recent.headline: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive and left its board, effective immediately. Nvidia closed down 4.3%, about 1.8 times its usual daily move.
Nvidia fell about 8% after hours on Wednesday, after the Wall Street Journal reported that its board is preparing to remove Jensen Huang as chief executive.
Nvidia fell another 5.5% on Tuesday, about 2.3 times its usual daily move, on twice its average volume. It is down 18.3% over five sessions.
US stocks had their biggest rally in about seven months on Monday: the S&P 500 fund rose 2.4% and the chip fund 7.5%.
Chip stocks bounced on Friday after their worst sell-off since 2020: the chip fund rose 3.5% and AMD 11%.
